description: Date palm grove on golden sand dunes under a clear blue sky (Taghit, Algeria). Wide landscape, no buildings.
alt: Palmeraie de dattiers au milieu des dunes de sable doré, sous un ciel bleu
notes: No people, no buildings, no text. Midday light (blue sky), warm sand. A small piece of litter (plastic) is visible in the foreground sand, left of center: retouch or crop before use. Location is Algeria: do not caption it as a Moroccan or brand plantation.

description: Heavy bunches of ripening orange and yellow dates hanging below the fronds of a date palm, pale overcast sky.
alt: Régimes de dattes orangées suspendus sous les palmes d'un dattier
notes: No people, no brands, no text. Bright, pale sky background (not moody). Unripe (khalal stage) dates, not Medjool.

description: Small wooden bowl of natural glossy dates on a wood slice, on dark brown textured fabric, with wheat ears in the foreground. Moody, low-key.
alt: Petit bol en bois rempli de dattes naturelles sur un tissu brun sombre
notes: Natural, unfilled, uncoated dates. No people, no brands, no text, no religious symbol in the image (the uploader is a mosque account and page tags mention Ramadan; the image itself is neutral). Wheat ears in the foreground can be cropped out.

description: Top-down view of a plain dark chocolate bar and a broken-off two-square piece, dusted with cocoa powder on a black background.

notes: Plain bar without any embossed logo or packaging. No people, no text. Not a praline nor a stuffed date, so it cannot be mistaken for the brand's products. Several other candidates were rejected because of embossed brand marks.

description: Old carved and fretworked wooden double door set in a white horseshoe arch, raw earthen wall, strong sunlight casting the arch's shadow across the door (Marrakesh).

notes: No people, no text, no calligraphy or religious symbol visible. Resolution is the lowest of the set (long side 2500 px): fine for half-width or card use, borderline for full-bleed hero on large screens.
